research_rationale:
Complete official original and full EO9830 PartsI–III were read and operative primary pages inspected. EO9830 opening makes the entire order effective May1,1947; PartIII expressly names the target and PartII restates the Civil Service Rules. The selected end is the named-target endpoint under the owner October21 unnamed-instruments ruling, not a finding that all substantive host-rule application stayed unchanged earlier. No own sunset, completed single assignment or independent original command survives outside the corrected inventory. Earlier unnamed host changes and savings are separately pinned in source_notes; no exact effective date is invented for qualified administrative candidates. The native original evidence is the actual FR representation; uncited derivative working-text leads receive no confirmation. EO8705 contains three rule replacements: I§1 political activity, XII§5 military-preference retention, XV discipline/dismissal and salary withholding. The express November7,1940 date is a retroactive start, not an end; signedMarch5,1941. Official9830page11also namesMarch5 while held OCR saysMarch6; number/subject/source match, exact quote remains unaltered. The1942Part18§18.11list excludesI,XII,XV, so its blanket supersession does not establish an earlier8705cessation. Full VPA1944§§1–21 was read with all5primarypages:§12independently governs retention and repeats the important rating comparisons,§14qualifies preference-employee removal,§18expressly saves prior personal rights. This unnamedJune27,1944 statutory regime is a disclosed earlier candidate for XII§5, not its named end. 1946§27.1(a)reenacts politics;§27.12retention/removal links statutory successor regulations;§27.15reenacts enforcement. EO9830successor§4.1and§§5.4–5.5provide new authority, with materially revised salary/enforcement steps; similar words do not revive8705. Finite later-source/current-application/revival checks: native U.S.Code search through2026-10-09 (not sufficient alone); eCFR point-in-time2026-10-14 plus49-title CFR corpus; OFR incoming/disposition search checked2026-10-19; additional5614 laternumeric heldFR files scanned by target numbers and earlierhost terms with contexts in producer COUNTEREVIDENCE_SCAN.v1.json. Only9830 is an applicable later naming hit after excluding originals/neighbor copies, FRdocument/page numbers, USC8707 and tariff noise. OfficialOFR1941table and official-domain websearch found no concrete revival/currentEOterm lead. Current sourceauthority does not follow from similar successor wording or completed appointments/status. Revoking or replacing9830 alone is insufficient to revive a target underTC11. These are bounded checks through cutoff, not universal-negative or human certification.  Fresh packet v9 explicitly reaffirms the same original inventory, original/page confirmations, selected sources, dates and member judgments against their unchanged held bytes; old producer approval is not inherited as an independent review.  The newly held April§27.9 source concerns reinstatement; it changes no8705politics, retention or withholding-salary footprint or prior savings/current-application judgment.
